_note: ⛔ SNG-408. AREAS. Erik: 'the disputed zone needs to be drawn on the map — it's an area. It has sublocations within it.' ⚠️ NO LOCATION IN CANON HAS A BOUNDARY FIELD — all 135 are points, including the 25 marked `tier: region`. This is the first area in the world.
_shapes: `lens` — the interference band between two powers: everywhere both fields are comparable. `hull` — the buffered extent of named members. `disc` — a centre and a radius. ⚠️ A LENS IS DERIVED, NOT DRAWN: give it two foci and a tolerance and it follows the powers if they ever move. That is the difference between an area and a polygon somebody typed.

disputed_zone.name: The Disputed Zone
disputed_zone.definition: ⛔ DERIVED FROM ITS OWN TEXT: 'the band of broken country WHERE HARMONIC AND RADIANT POWER FIELDS INTERFERE.' A point is in the zone when both powers are comparably distant — |d_harmonic − d_radiant| / separation < 0.35 — and neither is more than 1.1× the separation away. ⚠️ THE FICTION IS THE FORMULA. Sound bends light here because both reach equally.
disputed_zone.membershipRule: ⛔ ELLIPSE, NOT EQUIDISTANCE. A point is in the zone when d_harmonic + d_radiant <= 1.35 × separation. ⚠️ MY FIRST FORMULA TESTED ONLY ASYMMETRY — whether the two fields were comparably distant — AND THAT IS NOT BETWEENNESS. The Great Coliseum is exactly equidistant from both powers (18.2° and 18.2°, asymmetry 0.00) while sitting FAR OFF TO THE SIDE: a tall thin triangle, sum-over-separation 1.63. Erik caught it — it belongs to the Crossing and always did. An ellipse with both powers as foci is the correct shape and excludes it cleanly.
disputed_zone._namingNote: ⚠️ ERIK RECALLED 'the Radiant Heights and the Resonant Plateau'. CANON HAS THE QUALIFIERS THE OTHER WAY: `harmonic_heights_terrace` is 'Harmonic Heights — Lower Terrace', the SONIC civilization ('buildings grown from phononic crystal'), and `radiant_plateau_edge` is 'Radiant Plateau — Edge District', the PHOTONIC one ('towers catch and braid the sunlight'). The zone's own seed says 'where HARMONIC and RADIANT power fields interfere'. ⛔ So the foci are right; the pairing is Harmonic-Heights and Radiant-Plateau. Flagging rather than silently agreeing — if the intent was Resonant rather than Harmonic, that is a rename across several files and Erik's call.

_openQuestions.detail: ⛔ `disputed_zone_fringe` sits 67.7° — about 113 walking days — from the midpoint of the two powers. Predates SNG-407. It is not in its own zone.

_openQuestions.resolved: ⛔ RESOLVED BY MEASUREMENT, under the standing ruling. Erik: 'it's supposed to be within a few days walking — Silas and Pell walked there — a way out of the Valley.' ⚠️ THE TERRAIN CANNOT SUPPORT BOTH: Millbrook sits in country that is FLAT FOR 20 DAYS IN EVERY DIRECTION — nothing rises above it past 1°, the nearest real high ground is 22 days off, and the nearest mountain belt is 31 days away. THERE IS NO PASS WITHIN A FEW DAYS OF MILLBROOK. ⛔ BUT THE SWITCHBACK IS ALREADY WELL PLACED FOR EVERYTHING ELSE HE SAID: relief span 0.175 against Millbrook's 0.03 — real mountain country, matching its own seed ('stone-cut switchbacks clinging to the mountainside'); it reaches TWO REGIONS, the Echo Vale and the Foothills, so it genuinely IS a way out; and by the corrected ellipse it sits INSIDE the Disputed Zone at 1.11. ⚠️ A CONTESTED MOUNTAIN ROAD BETWEEN TWO POWERS IS A BETTER FIT THAN A LANE OUTSIDE A FARMING VILLAGE. Keeping it where it is. The 'few days from Millbrook' memory is recorded and not honoured.

_standingRuling: ⛔ ERIK, 2026-08-10: 'I'm more interested in finding good fits for WHAT we've created now that we have world geography, than trying to match what I experienced in a game where nothing was anchored yet.' ⚠️ STANDING PRECEDENCE: WORLD GEOGRAPHY OUTRANKS UNANCHORED PLAY MEMORY. Play happened before the terrain existed, so a remembered distance is a remembered FEELING, not a measurement. Where the two conflict, fit the geography and record what the memory said. ⛔ THIS DOES NOT DEMOTE PLAY-AUTHORED CONTENT — the Made Gate, the Watershed Road and the Far Side are canon because of what happened in them. It demotes only remembered POSITIONS.
